# MAKH Trading Platform — Data Vendor Due-Diligence Questionnaire

Last updated: 12 August 2026

| ID | Evidence request |
|---|---|
| VDD-01 | Identify upstream exchanges/SIPs/publishers and whether data is consolidated, direct, delayed or derived. |
| VDD-02 | Confirm U.S. common-share, exchange, session and pre/post-market coverage. |
| VDD-03 | Supply schemas for trades, quotes, bars, conditions, sequences, corrections, LULD/halts and corporate actions. |
| VDD-04 | State event-time accuracy, latency, completeness targets and historical/backfill availability. |
| VDD-05 | Explain bar eligibility, missing intervals, volume rules and split-adjustment behavior. |
| VDD-06 | Define public float precisely, exclusions, sources, as-of date, update frequency and correction history. |
| VDD-07 | Provide identifiers (CIK, FIGI, CUSIP/ISIN if licensed), symbol-history and corporate-action mapping. |
| VDD-08 | Describe news publishers, press-release sources, deduplication, corrections, entity matching and trust metadata. |
| VDD-09 | Specify whether headline, summary, image, full text and original URL may be stored and displayed. |
| VDD-10 | Specify server/non-display, derived calculation, personal, commercial, internal, external-user and public-display rights. |
| VDD-11 | Specify raw/derived retention, archival, audit snapshot, backup and deletion rights. |
| VDD-12 | Specify redistribution, screenshots, exports, alerts, caching and concurrent-user restrictions. |
| VDD-13 | Identify exchange/pass-through fees, user/device reporting and entitlement audit obligations. |
| VDD-14 | Provide rate/stream limits, connection policy, authentication, IP allowlisting and credential rotation. |
| VDD-15 | Provide SLA, status, incident notification, correction/backfill and support escalation terms. |
| VDD-16 | Provide privacy roles and rules for personal/social data, deletions and cross-border processing. |
| VDD-17 | Confirm whether data may be used for automated screening/ranking and what attribution/disclaimers apply. |
| VDD-18 | Confirm whether data may influence self-directed orders and identify prohibited automated-trading uses. |
| VDD-19 | Supply sandbox/sample data and permission for contract, replay, load and failure testing. |
| VDD-20 | Provide termination/export, deletion certification, price-change and API-deprecation provisions. |
